caption: A horse gallops toward a low fence, jumps over it, and lands on the far side.

sa.check: A horse gallops toward a fence.
It lands on the far side.
The gallop comes first, then the jump, then the landing.

pc.expect: The horse leaves the ground before the fence, arcs over it, lands beyond it and carries on forward.
pc.fail: The horse takes off after passing the fence; or it changes direction in mid-air; or it lands behind where it took off.

pc.expect: After the peak the horse comes down, front legs first, without hovering.
pc.fail: The horse hovers above the fence; or it rises again after starting down; or it lands and bounces high.

pc.expect: The gallop carries into the jump, and after landing the horse runs on.
pc.fail: The horse stops dead on landing; or slides forward on planted legs; or speeds up in mid-air.

pc.expect: The legs fold and extend through the jump, and the turf takes the landing.
pc.fail: The horse lands rigid; or it sinks into the ground; or the turf ripples like water.

pc.expect: One horse keeps its legs and shape, and it does not pass through the fence.
pc.fail: A leg detaches or vanishes; or the horse passes through a rail; or a second horse appears.

pc.expect: The horse's coat, the fence and the field stay the same.
pc.fail: The coat changes colour; or the fence changes height between frames; or the field rearranges.

note: The horse is the projectile; its body is the physics. Jumping form is not judged.
